Pilot Spots Mysterious Disc-Shaped Object Near London’s Gatwick Airport, Sparks UFO Debate Online
description: A pilot reported a mysterious disc-shaped object near London’s Gatwick Airport, documented in official aviation report. The object did not resemble a conventional aircraft, sparking online discussions about Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP). While the incident generated significant public interest and speculation, the object remains unidentified.
